package toolroute

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"

	"example.test/auth"
	"example.test/httperr"
	"example.test/runner"
)

type ToolSpec struct{ Name string }

type tool interface {
	Spec() ToolSpec
	Handle(ctx context.Context, in []byte) ([]byte, error)
}

type checkedTool struct{}

func (checkedTool) Spec() ToolSpec { return ToolSpec{Name: "checked_tool"} }

func (checkedTool) Handle(ctx context.Context, in []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	if err := auth.Require(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return []byte("1"), nil
}

type uncheckedTool struct{}

func (uncheckedTool) Spec() ToolSpec { return ToolSpec{Name: "unchecked_tool"} }

func (uncheckedTool) Handle(ctx context.Context, in []byte) ([]byte, error) { return []byte("1"), nil }

// Registry runs a tool by its name, through a map the walk cannot read.
type Registry struct{ tools map[string]tool }

func NewRegistry() *Registry {
	r := &Registry{tools: map[string]tool{}}
	for _, t := range []tool{checkedTool{}, uncheckedTool{}} {
		r.tools[t.Spec().Name] = t
	}
	return r
}

func (r *Registry) Invoke(ctx context.Context, name string, in []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	return r.tools[name].Handle(ctx, in)
}

func serveTool(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, invoke func(context.Context, string, []byte) ([]byte, error), name string) {
	out, err := invoke(r.Context(), name, nil)
	if err != nil {
		httperr.Write(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	w.Write(out)
}

type Handlers struct{ registry *Registry }

// A route the registry serves answers for the one tool it names.
func (h Handlers) GetCheckedTool(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	serveTool(w, r, h.registry.Invoke, "checked_tool")
}

func (h Handlers) GetUncheckedTool(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	serveTool(w, r, h.registry.Invoke, "unchecked_tool")
}

// A name the walk cannot read leaves the registry, which checks nothing.
func (h Handlers) GetToolByPath(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	serveTool(w, r, h.registry.Invoke, r.URL.Path)
}

// A wrapper that is handed one name and then names another runs the other.
func serveRenamed(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, invoke func(context.Context, string, []byte) ([]byte, error), name string) {
	name = "unchecked_tool"
	serveTool(w, r, invoke, name)
}

func (h Handlers) GetRenamedTool(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	serveRenamed(w, r, h.registry.Invoke, "checked_tool")
}

// An outside runner need not hand its callback the arguments it was given.
func (h Handlers) GetToolThroughARunner(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	runner.Run(r.Context(), "checked_tool", func(ctx context.Context, name string) {
		serveTool(w, r, h.registry.Invoke, name)
	})
}

func invokeUnchecked(ctx context.Context, name string, in []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	return uncheckedTool{}.Handle(ctx, in)
}

// A wrapper that is handed one function and then calls another runs the other.
func serveRewired(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, invoke func(context.Context, string, []byte) ([]byte, error), name string) {
	invoke = invokeUnchecked
	serveTool(w, r, invoke, name)
}

func (h Handlers) GetRewiredTool(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	serveRewired(w, r, h.registry.Invoke, "checked_tool")
}
